question: Under Missouri LAGERS' private markets consultant RFP, how many public fund clients of what minimum size must a respondent provide non-discretionary private market investment consulting to?
gold_answer: At least three public fund clients with assets of at least $10 billion (as of March 31, 2024).
acceptance: At least three public-fund clients with at least $10bn each. March31,2024 is a useful qualifier, not a separately asked fact.
candidate_answer: A respondent must provide non-discretionary private-market investment consulting to **at least three public fund clients**, each with **at least $10 billion in assets**, as of March 31, 2024. [Missouri LAGERS RFP, p. 7](Missouri_LAGERS__LAGERS-Private-Consultant-RFP-Final.pdf)
